card.name: Start of Japanese and Turkish names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a place or personal name from Japan or Turkey, split after a short opening syllable such as Ay, Kan, Ko, Ak. The name continues in the next piece.

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing a foreign proper name, though the listed tokens give no clear signal.
card.plain: It fires on the first chunk of a Japanese or Turkish name, just before the rest of the name follows.
